name: live-checklist
description: A problem-and-fix explainer above the prompt that Claude keeps up to date

retry.title: Run failed helpers again one tier up
retry.description: When a helper the router placed fails (error, refusal or empty answer), run it once more on the next tier up. Up to 3 a prompt.

alwaysLow.title: Always use the low tier for
alwaysLow.description: Comma-separated words. A helper whose agent type or description contains one runs on the low tier (Haiku).

alwaysMid.title: Always use the mid tier for
alwaysMid.description: Comma-separated words. A helper whose agent type or description contains one runs on the mid tier (Sonnet).

alwaysHigh.title: Always use the high tier for
alwaysHigh.description: Comma-separated words. A helper whose agent type or description contains one runs on the high tier (Opus). Beats the other two.
